title: Dummy app 2
tagline: Collaborative document vault platform with real-time synchronization.
overview: Shared Vault is a collaborative document management platform that allows multiple users to organize, store, and synchronize documents in real time.
problem: Users needed a secure shared workspace that supported collaboration and offline access while maintaining data consistency.
solution: Implemented an offline-first architecture using local persistence and Firebase synchronization. Added conflict resolution mechanisms and real-time updates across devices.
architecture: The application follows MVVM architecture with Firebase Authentication, Firestore, and local caching for offline support.
metrics: Enabled real-time updates across multiple users

challenges.title: Conflict Resolution
challenges.description: Multiple users could edit the same document simultaneously.

challenges.title: Offline Support
challenges.description: Changes needed to persist locally and synchronize once connectivity returned.
